classification_vocabulary.in_scope: The canonical source identity may be consumed by T14-T19 or is already represented by a closed runtime slice. This does not promise complete implementation.
classification_vocabulary.deferred_with_reason: The source identity is valid but requires a named later owner, reason, replacement condition and recheck point.
classification_vocabulary.out_of_scope: The source identity belongs to an explicitly excluded gameplay or compatibility axis.
classification_vocabulary.unclassified: No reviewed disposition exists. Any occurrence blocks T13 readiness.

recipe_maps: empty nameInternal is represented by the explicit canonical id unnamed
prefixes: source aliases and compatibility variants may map to one OP canonical prefix only through an attributed mapping rule
itemgenerator_domains: one domain may map to multiple prefixes or a declared Boolean expression
machine_kinds: registrations differing only by material, input window, parallel or other numeric tier values collapse into variants
energy_identities: local enum/topology mapping does not merge distinct GT6 TagData identities
cover_kinds: abstract bases, interfaces, helpers, renderers and data-only companions are exclusions rather than canonical behaviors
multiblock_kinds: parts, ports, abstract bases and data-only companions are exclusions rather than canonical controllers
